name: Make panels resizable with stored widths
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Objective**: Implement persistent storage for Vibe Coding panel visibility and width settings in the UI state.

2. **Solution**: Added `vibePanelVisibility` and `panelWidths` objects to the UI store to track which panels (chat, changes, preview) are visible and their dimensions.

3. **Key Mutations**: Created `setVibePanelVisibility()` and `setPanelWidth()` mutations that automatically save state changes to persistent storage.

4. **Component Methods**: Implemented `loadPanelState()` to restore settings on mount and `savePanelState()` to persist changes when panels are toggled or resized.

5. **Result**: Users can now toggle panels on/off, resize them, and their preferences are automatically saved and restored when they return to the Vibe Coding view.

<script setup>
</script>

<template>
  <div
    class="w-1 bg-base-content/5 hover:bg-primary/30 cursor-col-resize transition-colors active:bg-primary/50 shrink-0"
    @mousedown="startResize"
  />
</template>

<script>
export default {
  props: {
    onResize: {
      type: Function,
      required: true
    }
  },
  data() {
    return {
      startX: 0,
      startWidth: 0
    }
  },
  methods: {
    startResize(event) {
      this.startX = event.clientX
      this.startWidth = this.$el.parentElement.offsetWidth
      
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', this.handleResize)
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', this.stopResize)
    },
    handleResize(event) {
      const delta = event.clientX - this.startX
      const newWidth = this.startWidth + delta
      this.onResize(newWidth)
    },
    stopResize() {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.handleResize)
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.stopResize)
    }
  }
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { SplitterGroup, SplitterPanel, SplitterResizeHandle } from 'radix-vue'
</script>

<template>
  <SplitterGroup :id="groupId" direction="horizontal">
    <SplitterPanel
      :id="`${groupId}-panel-splitter-1`"
      :min-size="panels?.left?.minSize || 10"
      :collapsible="panels?.left?.collapsible || true"
      :defaultSize="panels?.left?.defaultSize || 20"
      :class="panels?.left?.class"
      :style="panels?.left?.style"
      style="overflow: auto !important"
      :order="1"
      v-if="$slots.left"
    >
      <slot name="left"></slot>
    </SplitterPanel>
    <SplitterResizeHandle
      :id="`${groupId}-panel-divider`"
      class="border-r border-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-600 w-2"
      v-if="$slots.left && $slots.right"
    >
    </SplitterResizeHandle>
    <SplitterPanel
      :id="`${groupId}-panel-splitter-2`"
      :min-size="panels?.right?.minSize || 10"
      :collapsible="panels?.right?.collapsible || true"
      :defaultSize="panels?.right?.defaultSize || 20"
      :class="panels?.right?.class"
      :style="panels?.right?.style"
      style="overflow: auto !important"
      :order="2"
      v-if="$slots.right"
    >
      <slot name="right"></slot>
    </SplitterPanel>
  </SplitterGroup>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  props: ['panels'],
  computed: {
    groupId() {
      const t = this.generateUID()
      return `splitter-group-${t}`
    }
  }
}
</script>

messages.content: Panel width and vibe options (chat, cahnges, preview) are not stored in th UI state and recovered when reopening a vibe session. Make sure visible panels options  and widths are stored in ui

# Solution I'll help you persist the panel visibility options and widths in the UI state. Here's what needs to be changed: ## 1. Update the UI Store ```js client/src/store/ui.js export const state = () => ({ // ... existing state ... panelWidths: { chat: 30, changes: 33, preview: 37 }, vibePanelVisibility: { chat: true, changes: false, preview: true } }) ``` Add mutations to store panel visibility: ```js client/src/store/ui.js export const mutations = mutationTree(state, { // ... existing mutations ... setPanelWidth(state, { panel, width }) { state.panelWidths = { ...state.panelWidths, [panel]: width } $storex.ui.saveState() }, setVibePanelVisibility(state, visibility) { state.vibePanelVisibility = { ...state.vibePanelVisibility, ...visibility } $storex.ui.saveState() } }) ``` ## 2. Update VibeCodingView Component ```vue client/src/views/VibeCodingView.vue
